source_kind: AI-generated original raster UI surface, using the original project merchant/items master only as a color and pixel-cluster style reference.

reference_images.role: Style and color reference only; do not copy merchant or goods.

processing: Original generated RGB PNG copied unchanged. Pillow used only to inspect dimensions, RGB samples and edge transitions. No image edits, crops, resampling, quantization or regeneration.
reuse: Offered as a repository example under the root MIT license only to the extent rights are held; no guarantee of exclusive authorship, uniqueness or independent copyright protection.

visual_review.method: Generated output and saved original actually viewed at full composition size.
observed: Complete front-facing cream rectangular panel with continuous dark/brown border and small stepped corners.
Center is empty and visually quiet; no text, line grid, buttons, goods, people, gems or metal decoration.
The cream/brown family and colored dark outline are related to the merchant/items master.
Corners have small block-like reinforced-looking joins and the wood has several tonal bands; these are more modeled than the requested simplest two-shade frame.
limits: Border is about 32–38 source pixels at edge midpoints, not the requested approximately 16.
Corner detail extends farther inward than the straight border, so source slices must contain the full step.
Center is nearly uniform but not mathematically one RGB color; sample points differ by roughly one or two channel values.
Exact two-shade wood, strict palette membership, uniform logical pixel grid and final 4px rendering quality are not certified.
No rendered application screenshot or final nine-slice join test is claimed by this source inspection.

measurements.paper_classifier: First pixel inward with R>=210, G>=185, B>=135; a task-local measurement heuristic, not a material classifier.
measurements.corner_observations: Near left corner, first paper x is 55 at y=40; near right corner, first paper y is 65 at x=1503. Straight-edge paper starts settle by approximately 64 source pixels from corners.

nine_slice_recommendation.reason: 72px contains the measured stepped corner transitions with a small margin. A 4px destination strip includes both wood and a narrow cream inner area; straight visible wood is approximately 2 logical pixels, not a guaranteed solid 4px wood band.
nine_slice_recommendation.rendering_note: Use the source nine regions in the application; preserve the original file. This is a measured candidate and still needs native-stage visual inspection for seams and corner readability.

production_status: SOURCE_INSPECTED_RENDER_REVIEW_PENDING: quiet original UI panel source; exact native-grid/palette and rendered joins unverified.
